content.title: UFC White House: Full card, date, fan event details and how fight week will work
content.text: The UFC White House show is approaching thick and fast, and fans are eager to soak up all the details.UFC president Dana White has already announced the full card for the celebratory show, which is being officially billed as UFC Freedom 250.7Trump, who is often seen front row at huge UFC events, had a front row seat for UFC 327 in AprilCredit: GettyIn July, Trump revealed plans to hold a 'championship fight' to mark 250 years of American independence.The 79-year-old has attended several UFC events, including UFC 316 in New Jersey in June 2025, as well as UFC 314 and UFC 327 in Miami.Trump is a close friend and ally of White, who gave a speech at the politician's inauguration in early 2025.His association with the chief MMA promotion dates back to 2001, when the now-closed Trump Taj Mahal hosted UFC 30 and UFC 31.Dana White shares stunning images of how UFC White House card could look"Does anybody watch UFC? The great Dana White? We're going to have a UFC fight," Trump said, speaking in July.“We're going to have a UFC fight - think of this - on the grounds of the White House — we have a lot of land there.”White then made the event official before issuing remarkable images of what the epic card will look like on fight night.His update came just a few weeks after the announcement of the promotion's new $7.7billion broadcast deal with CBS and Paramount+, which started two big cards in UFC 324 and UFC 325 at the beginning of 2026.UFC White House is set to be a historic first-ever UFC event in the home of the President, and it has got the entire MMA world talking.UFC White House date and live streamUFC Freedom 250 will take place on June 14, Trump's 80th birthday.7White is a close friend of Trump, who hosted UFC 30 and UFC 31 in 2001 at the now-closed Trump Taj MahalCredit: AFPTrump originally wanted the event to celebrate 250 years of American independence on July 4, 2026.However, The Wall Street Journal reported the date was moved to a day in June to accommodate plans the President already had in place, under the banner of his 'Freedom 250' initiative.It will stream live on Paramount+ for US fans and TNT Sports on HBO Max in the UK.Full UFC White House cardMAIN EVENT: Ilia Topuria vs Justin Gaethje - UFC Lightweight titleCO-MAIN EVENT: Alex Pereira vs Ciryl Gane - interim UFC Heavyweight titleSean O’Malley vs Aiemann Zahabi - BantamweightMauricio Ruffy vs Michael Chandler - LightweightBo Nickal vs Kyle Daukaus - MiddleweightDiego Lopes vs Steve Garcia - FeatherweightWhere exactly will UFC White House take place and how many people will be there?White has confirmed the event will be held outdoors on the South Lawn of the White House."We literally just got done going through all the logistics of how to set it up there, how many people we can have," he told CBS Mornings in January.7White has shared spectacular images of how the show will look on the night, with the main event expected to host the return of Conor McGregorCredit: UFC7UFC White House is set to have a press conference and fighter weigh-ins on the steps of the Lincoln MemorialCredit: UFC"It’s looking like we’ll have 5,000 people live on the White House lawn - on the South Lawn."Then, across the street is the park, it’s called The Ellipse, and we can have 85,000 people there."We're gonna have big screens, a stage, music throughout the day."We’re basically going to take over DC that whole week with lots of different things for fight fans."The fighters will actually walk from the Oval Office to the Octagon."Fan events confirmedIt was confirmed during UFC 327 in April that the promotion will put on several events in the build-up to the historic show.Paddy Pimblett explains why he isn't interested in UFC White House fight as Dana White announces new plansOn Friday, June 12, the UFC Freedom 250 press conference will take place at the Lincoln Memorial from 8pm ET (5pm PT, 1am UK).The press conference is free and open to the public.Then, on the Saturday, the first UFC Freedom 250 fan fest takes place for the ceremonial weigh-in at The Ellipse between 3:30-11:30pm ET (12:30-8:30pm PT, 8:30-4:30am UK).The promotion has promised live music, panels and Q&As, and athlete meet and greets for the free ticketed event.The same then applies on fight night on Sunday, June 14, for the UFC Freedom 250 watch party.Fans will also be able to access the event free of charge, with more information available on UFCFreedom250.com.7White has put his faith in UFC lightweight champion Topuria to headline the White House cardCredit: GettyFighters are also expected to be allowed warm-up space in the White House itself.White also revealed in October that he will have to stomach a mind-blowing $700,000 to replace the grass on the South Lawn, where the Octagon will be placed."This is a one-of-one experience," the UFC CEO told the Spinning Backfist MMA Show in early 2026."It's going to be incredible. Not just for the fighters and the fans, but the staff who get to work this event."I have 500 employees just in Vegas - everybody wants to work this thing."We’re going to have to be selective in who we pick to come work it.7Trump's links to Dana White and the UFC date back more than 20 yearsCredit: Getty7Topuria and Gaethje will headline the White House card on June 14 for the UFC lightweight titleCredit: Getty"I’m going to have the department heads start giving me a list of who they think is going to go and who they want."We're going to figure out how many we really need and how many we don't."For all the upcoming fights and results this year, check out talkSPORT.com's UFC schedule.
